title: My Help Comes from the Lord

request.style: English, Armenian sacred chant, a soprano soloist answered by a women's choir, duduk and a soft kanun over a drone, ancient mode, mountain stillness, steady and trusting, 64 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I lift up my eyes to the mountains
Where does my help come from
My help comes from the Lord
Who made heaven and earth

[Chorus]
He who keeps you will not slumber
He who keeps Israel will not sleep

[Verse]
The Lord is your keeper
The Lord is your shade at your right hand
The sun shall not strike you by day
Nor the moon by night

[Chorus]
He who keeps you will not slumber
He who keeps Israel will not sleep

[Outro]
From this time forth and forevermore
